title: در کافه چه بگوییم؟
introduction: این مکالمه کوتاه را بخوان و به عبارت‌های پرکاربرد هنگام سفارش توجه کن.
paragraphs: Barista: Hello! What would you like?
Customer: Hi. Can I have a cup of tea, please?
Barista: Of course. Would you like anything else?
Customer: No, thank you. How much is it?
Customer: Here you are. Thank you!
Barista: You’re welcome. Have a nice day!
